notes.title: Nephilim Uprising Major Monday October 21st – Revamped Gameplay & New Features!
notes.content:
Exciting news for all Nephilim Uprising players—our latest major update is just around the corner! 
Here’s what you can expect:


Updated Visual Graphics: Experience the game in an all-new light with enhanced visuals.

Updated Background Music: Dive deeper into the action with newly composed background music to set the tone.

Mob and Player Balance: We’ve updated health and damage values for mobs and players, creating a better-balanced experience.

New Weapons & Updated Damage: Unlock powerful new weapons, each with rebalanced damage to match the game’s new difficulty levels.

Skill and Leveling Systems: A revamped leveling system introduces a skill and skill point system, giving you more control over your character’s progression.

Improved Inventory System: We’ve added new features, including a merchant, selling options, and overall inventory improvements.

Level Quality & Difficulty Adjustments: Levels have been improved for a smoother experience, with difficulty adjustments to keep you on your toes.

Currency System: Collect and use a new in-game currency to make purchases and upgrades.

Boss Level Separation: Boss battles are now on dedicated levels, separated from regular gameplay for a more focused challenge.

We're excited to bring these changes to you, and keep an eye on this space for more details and prepare to jump back into Nephilim Uprising! ⚔️"

And that’s not all! We’ll be hosting a live stream event shortly after the update drops, showcasing all the new features and answering your burning questions! Stay tuned for the stream date!
